title: Measure the Lore pane's full-size request against what the engine grants, in both placements (inline and dock), and report honestly where they differ
description:
Filed 2026-10-03 at opum-agent's request (its relay of opum-doc seq 223, recorded on opum-agent OPAG-1075 at origin/dev, opum-ai/opum-agent#1972), after the operator found the defect in quest-cli's board mod: in full mode the pane never changed size while the tool reported "Opened ..., full screen." and the header read "Full screen". The same check is owed on the Lore pane mod (hooks/register.tsx, this repository).

The pane already carries the honest-size mechanism (LCLI-666/LCLI-668): full mode asks `columns - 20` when docked or `rows - 6` when inline, and draws FULL_HINT whenever the drawn size is more than SIZE_SLACK (4) below the asked size. What is NOT yet measured is the engine's side in a real pty: what the request resolves to, what the render actually grants, in BOTH placements -- the main screen (inline, above the prompt) and the fullscreen transcript (dock) -- and whether the pane id carries a kept (dragged or keyed) size that overrides the request.

Lead from opum-doc, read from the 2.1.288 PaneOpenArgs declaration and to be MEASURED rather than taken as a diagnosis: `rows` applies only while the pane is seated inline above the prompt, "up to what the layout spares"; `columns` applies only while docked beside a fullscreen transcript; in both, a size the person dragged or keyed wins, this session's or a kept one.

Method precedent: the LCLI-672 probe (/private/tmp/lcli672-probe/drive.py, a Python pty driver that sizes the pty, drives keystrokes and captures the screen) ran a scratch plugin in a real `claude` session at a chosen cols x rows. Reuse that shape against a staged copy of the real mod with a diagnostic line added (a measurement build in /tmp only; nothing hand-edited in the repository).

Constraints: if main-screen mode can never grant a full-size pane, that is a design issue to REPORT to opum-agent with the measurement -- no workaround invented here. LCLI-665 stays held; this task does not touch it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Full mode is measured in a real pty at a named Claude Code version, in BOTH placements (inline on the main screen; docked beside a fullscreen transcript), and each run records the size the pane asked for, the size the render granted, and the terminal size the run used.

For each measured frame, whether the held-size hint was drawn is consistent with that frame own asked-vs-granted numbers: present when the drawn size is short of the asked size beyond the mod own slack, absent otherwise; if one of the two cases is unreachable in a real session, the report says so rather than claiming the hint was exercised.

Whether a kept size exists for the pane id (a size the person dragged or keyed, this session or a kept one) that overrides the full-size request is measured and reported; where it cannot be measured from this seat, the report says what blocked it.
Any placement that cannot grant the size full mode asks for is reported to opum-agent as a design issue with the measurement, and no workaround is landed in this repository.
The measurement, its artifacts location, and its findings are reported to opum-agent at the PR boundary or as a finding, whichever the result calls for.

plan: 1. Stage a measurement build in /private/tmp/lcli674-probe: the shipped plugin (hooks, types, skills, .claude-plugin) with one diagnostic line added to the pane draw showing mode, placement, viewport, asked size, drawn size and hint presence.
2. Drive it in a real pty (drive.py precedent) at named sizes: fullscreen layout (dock) and main screen (inline), toggling full via ctrl+x tab then z; capture raw frames.
3. Extract per-frame asked/granted/hint numbers; check hint honesty both ways; test whether the pane id carries a kept size that overrides the request.
4. Report measurements to opum-agent; land a fix with mod tests only if a defect is found, else the report is the finding.
implementationNotes:
MEASURED (AC1-AC3). Claude Code 2.1.288, real ptys (tmux), the SHIPPING mod staged in /private/tmp/lcli674-probe with ONE diagnostic Text line added to the pane body (the repo was never hand-edited). Artifacts: /private/tmp/lcli674-probe/out-*/frame-*.txt and measurement-note.md there.

THE HONEST-SIZE RULE HOLDS. In every captured frame the hint is drawn exactly when drawn < asked - 4, and absent otherwise: full-when-short frames carry it, normal-mode and dock frames do not. The pane never silently claims a size it did not get.

WHAT FULL ASKS AND GETS, native module, by placement:
- INLINE (main screen, CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER=0, isFullscreen=false). Asks rows-6 (43 at 49 rows; 63 at 69). Granted body rows when content is tall: 36 at 49 rows, 14 in normal mode (Read tab, 150-paragraph doc, out-read: full 36 vs normal 14, full visibly grows the pane). Browse with 31 concepts: full 10 vs normal 9 (ONE row). Browse with 1 concept: 6 vs 5. At 69 rows with 40 filler rows: 46 (its content height) vs ask 63. Hint drawn in every full frame, absent in every normal frame.
- DOCK (fullscreen layout, isFullscreen=true). e.viewport reports the CONVERSATION region (80 columns at a 160-wide terminal), so the module asks columns = vp-20 = 60 -- a shrink request. Granted 79 body columns / 80-wide pane, UNCHANGED by the full/normal toggle (out-dock frames 1 and 3 both drawn=79); no hint, because drawn (79) > ask (60).

ENGINE ARITHMETIC, read from the decompiled 2.1.288 build (cc-patch analysis/rebuild-2.1.288/chunk-mcm8e5ww.js; $A dockColumns, zA inlineRows, oM/RL kept persistence). Every prediction from this model matched every pty capture:
- dock width = chosen (in-session person size, else kept pluginPanes.dockColumns) if present, else requested (pane columns + 1) clamped [24, cols-24], else default min(floor(0.45*cols), 90, cols-70);
- inline allowance on the main screen = max(rows/3, rows-11) (PROMPT_FLOOR_ROWS 8 + TRANSCRIPT_PEEK_ROWS 3), request clamped to it; a third in the fullscreen layout;
- inline pane cells = min(allowance, measured content height): inline panes are CONTENT-SIZED, which is why the same ask drew 6 (1 concept), 10 (31 concepts), 36 (long doc) and 46 (40 filler rows).

FINDINGS (routed to opum-agent as design issues; NO change landed here, no workaround invented):
1. MAIN SCREEN: the module's ask (rows-6) exceeds the engine's ceiling (rows-11) by 5 in every case, so full mode can never be granted as asked there; the hint always shows in full. The design constant PROMPT_AREA_ROWS=6 disagrees with the engine's 8+3=11 reservation.
2. DOCK: with a kept size present (this machine carries pluginPanes.dockColumns=80) every request is IGNORED -- measured asks of 60 (native), 110 (the band's asked press) and 140 (fixed probe, both unasked and seat-time) all left the pane 80 wide at a 160 terminal, and the toggle changes nothing. A person's drag wins and persists (110 survived a NEW process). Source says a request IS honored when no kept value exists, but clamped to [24, cols-24], so the design's 20-column transcript margin can never be met; the module's dock ask is also computed from the conversation width rather than the terminal width.
3. THE TOOL'S ANSWER CLAIMS THE ASK: photographed in out-read frame-2, "Opened the Lore pane, note-00 on Read, the full size." while want=43 and drawn=36 with the pane's hint showing. The placement arms report the engine's truth; the size arm does not.

KEPT SIZE (AC3): pluginPanes.dockColumns in ~/.claude.json -- global across pane ids and plugins, set by a person's drag (SGR mouse measured), persisted across processes, and it beats every request. There is no per-pane-id kept size in the engine; the key is one value for all docked panes.

LIMITS, named: the no-kept-value dock arm and the inlineRows kept clause are source-read only -- clearing or adding those keys needs an edit to ~/.claude.json, one such edit was refused by the auto-mode classifier and was deliberately NOT worked around. One drag was made and undone: dock 80 -> 110 -> 80 by dragging back, verified in the file. Probe design, run scripts and raw frames live in /private/tmp/lcli674-probe.
finalSummary: Measured 2026-10-03 on Claude Code 2.1.288 in real ptys (tmux), the shipping mod staged in /private/tmp/lcli674-probe with one diagnostic line; artifacts and measurement-note.md there. The held-size hint is honest in every frame. Full mode works on the main screen only as far as content reaches (Read with a long doc: 14 -> 36 rows; Browse with 31 concepts: 9 -> 10), and the ask (rows-6) can never be granted against the engine's rows-11 ceiling. In the dock every request is ignored while a kept pluginPanes.dockColumns exists (measured 60/110/140), drags win and persist, and the tool's answer still says "the full size". Three design questions routed to opum-agent for opum-doc; no change landed in this repository (PR opum-ai/lore-cli#484, tracker-only).
